evals.prompt: у меня есть сгенерированный принт тигра skills/vectorization-workspace/inputs/tiger-print.png (5500x5500, прозрачный фон). нужно перевести его в вектор, чтобы можно было печатать DTF любого размера без потери качества. сделай svg и покажи что получилось
evals.expected_output: Clean SVG with viewBox and transparent background (no white box), reasonable file size, visually faithful to the tiger; preview PNG shown; report of engine/settings/size/fidelity.
assertions: An SVG file was produced
SVG root has a viewBox (scales to any print size)
Background stays transparent (>=40% transparent, source ~48%)
Visual fidelity vs source >= 0.95
SVG under 15 MB
A PNG preview of the vector result was produced

evals.prompt: Хочу напечатать этого тигра шелкографией, у типографии лимит 6 цветов. Файл skills/vectorization-workspace/inputs/tiger-print.png. Подготовь вектор на 6 плашечных цветов и разложи по отдельным файлам на каждый цвет (цветоделение), плюс список цветов в hex.
evals.expected_output: SVG limited to <=6 spot colors (plus transparency), non-overlapping per-color separation SVGs, hex palette list with coverage, preview image.
assertions: Composite SVG produced
Composite uses at most 6 distinct fill colors
Composite has a viewBox
Background stays transparent (not printed as ink)
Composite fidelity vs source >= 0.90
Between 2 and 6 per-color separation SVGs, each single-color
Separations do not overlap (<2% of inked pixels in 2+ layers)
Reply lists the spot colors as hex codes (>=2)
Palette has no near-duplicate inks (min RGB distance >= 60)

evals.prompt: have this black & white badge design skills/vectorization-workspace/inputs/stay-wild-stamp.jpg — which tracer gives the cleanest svg for it? try the options and give me the best one, text has to stay crisp
evals.expected_output: Comparison of multiple engines with previews/contact sheet, a single recommended SVG (likely potrace bw: 1 fill, small file), crisp text, justified recommendation; notes the off-white background handling.
assertions: best.svg produced
best.svg is 1-2 colors (true B&W, no gray fringe layers)
best.svg has a viewBox
best.svg fidelity vs source >= 0.97 (text crisp)
best.svg under 150 KB
At least 2 tracers actually compared (named in reply)
best.svg compact: under 80 KB
compare auto-pick "best" is not a bloated trace (<1 MB)

evals.prompt: принт skills/vectorization-workspace/inputs/wild-heart-5x6.png получился маленький, всего 1000x1200. для печати нужен 4500x5400. увеличь его через вектор чтобы края и надпись были четкие, фон должен остаться прозрачным
evals.expected_output: Trace to SVG, export a 4500x5400 transparent PNG at 300 DPI with crisp text edges; preview shown; report of sizes.
assertions: Print PNG at exactly 4500x5400
PNG has an alpha channel (transparent background possible)
PNG carries 300 DPI metadata
Export matches source when scaled back down (fidelity >= 0.95)
Text edges crisper than a Lanczos upscale (transition pixels < 50% of Lanczos)
Letter shapes match ground truth (text-mask IoU >= 0.97)
